property_summary: For any caller equal to the deployer-admin and any address a, calling setOwner(a) must set owner to a (c.owner() == a afterwards); the mutant instead updates the private admin, so owner stays msg.sender and the rule fails whenever a != owner.
change_summary: Replace 'owner = _owner;' with 'admin = _owner;' so the call updates the admin address instead of the owner.
